# embeddings-similarity

> Vector math and in-memory embedding search — cosine/dot/euclidean, normalization, heap-based top-K, k-means-lite.

embeddings-similarity provides the core vector operations agents need when
working with embeddings: cosine/dot/euclidean distance, L2 normalization,
top-K nearest-neighbor search using a bounded min-heap (not a full sort, so
memory stays O(k) not O(n)), batch top-K across multiple queries, and a
fixed-iteration seeded k-means for lightweight clustering. All comparisons
throw a typed `DimensionMismatchError` on mismatched vector lengths. This is
brute-force exact search: fine up to roughly 100k vectors on a single
machine; beyond that, use a real vector database (pgvector, Pinecone,
Weaviate, etc). Zero runtime dependencies, strict TypeScript.

## API

- `cosineSimilarity(a: Vector, b: Vector): number`
- `dot(a: Vector, b: Vector): number`
- `euclideanDistance(a: Vector, b: Vector): number`
- `magnitude(a: Vector): number`
- `normalize(a: Vector): Vector`
- `topK<T>(query: Vector, vectors: VectorEntry<T>[], k: number, metric?: SimilarityMetric): TopKResult<T>[]`
- `batchTopK<T>(queries: Vector[], vectors: VectorEntry<T>[], k: number, metric?: SimilarityMetric): TopKResult<T>[][]`
- `kmeansLite(vectors: Vector[], options: KMeansOptions): KMeansResult`
- `class DimensionMismatchError extends Error`
- Types: `Vector`, `SimilarityMetric` ("cosine"|"dot"|"euclidean"), `VectorEntry<T>`, `TopKResult<T>`, `KMeansOptions`, `KMeansResult`

## Install

```
npm install embeddings-similarity
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
